content.text: {"incident_detected":false,"root_cause_hypothesis":"The March-to-May dip in Romanian card spend per active user is modest and does not indicate a clear decline in card usage. Spend per active user fell from €319.55 in March to €312.60 in May, while active users and total card spend both increased. Transaction frequency per active user softened slightly, but remained close to March’s level; the longer monthly history also shows normal variation, including a sharp December spike.","supporting_metrics":[{"name":"Romania card spend per active user","baseline_value":319.548121,"anomaly_value":312.602723,"unit":"EUR/user","sql":"SELECT a.month, SUM(a.card_spend_eur) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT a.user_id) FILTER (WHERE a.is_active),0) AS spend_per_active_user FROM fct_activity_monthly a JOIN dim_users u USING(user_id) WHERE u.country='RO' AND a.month BETWEEN DATE total_card_spend FROM fct_activity_monthly a JOIN dim_users u USING(user_id) WHERE u.country='RO' AND a.month BETWEEN DATE '2026-03-01' AND DATE '2026-05-01' GROUP BY a.month ORDER BY a.month"},{"name":"Romania card transactions per active user","baseline_value":11.947109,"anomaly_value":11.793446,"unit":"count/user","sql":"SELECT a.month, SUM(a.n_card_txns) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT '2026-05-01' GROUP BY a.month ORDER BY a.month"}],"recommended_action":"NO_ACTION_NOISE","reasoning_summary":"Spend per active user eased from €319.55 in March to €312.60 in May, but active users rose
